name: Base44
tagline: A no-code AI app builder that turns a description into a working app, with database, logins and hosting included.
about: Base44 builds complete apps from a conversation. The database, user accounts and hosting are set up for you, so there is nothing to connect yourself.
pros: Database, user accounts and hosting are built in.
No coding needed to get a working app.
cons: Less control than writing the code yourself.
Message credits limit how much you can build on lower plans.
